messages.subject: Debugging app on the server
parts:
Hi all,

I have an error ("cannot open the connection") on my Shiny app when I try to run something on it on the ShinyApps server but all works fine when I run it on my app locally. The helpful debugging R Shiny tutorial on http://www.rstudio.com/shiny/lessons/Lesson-10/ gives instructions for debugging the app locally, but what options do I have for debugging an app on the ShinyApps server?

Thanks!

Regards,
JinRou

messages.author: e84e7628b5f8a3e1
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Debugging app on the server
parts:
JinRou,

Unfortunately, ShinyApps does not currently expose the log information for an running application. We're looking at fixing soon, as many people have raised the same issue.

However, If you send me the URL of your application, I can inspect the logs for you. Feel free to reply directly to me if you do not want to share the URL.

-Andy
